top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.33(c)(1)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Staff and volunteers obtain documentation showing immunization with 2 doses measles/mumps, 1 dose rubella, 2 doses varicella and 1 dose Tdap. Medical exemptions only. History of measles, mumps or rubella shall Not replace MMR vaccine except in presence of MMR varicella antibodies.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.23(a)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Constant and competent supervision provided by adequate staff for children and groups of children

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.37(b)(1)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection it was determined that child care service failed to ensure staff received required training within time frames and/or failed to maintain training records.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §43.11(b)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: School-based child care staff observed caring for children while unhealthy. Staff medical certificate of fitness Not provided.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.33(b)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection it was determined that child care service allows staff to perform their duties that are Not healthy or are incapable of carrying out their duties. Staff medical clearances are Not maintained by child care service.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.29(c)(1)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Epi auto injector Not provided, Not maintained or expired.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §48.17(c)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: All staff have had a medical examination indicating they are fit for duty within 2 years of working in camp.

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.25(a)(2)(B)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Enrolled children 6 months to 59 months have Not received FDA approved annual influenza immunization by December 31 of the year
